code_correctness.reason: The eight voice prompts do not ask for an executable code solution. Teacher-forced accuracy on training code examples measures target reproduction, not functional correctness on unseen code tasks.

artifact_recovery.excluded_reason: Truncated examples GGUF caused an execution failure before meaningful inference; that crash is not a behavioral model result.

comparison.matched_controls: Both valid runs use the same eight prompts, per-case prompt hashes, case and identity hashes, decoding settings and rubric. Both selected models are epoch12.
comparison.identity: Neither objective provides the requested expanded identity and role on its heldout identity prompt; both outputs loop to the token limit. Neither corrects the false-biography premise. Both fail the forced-binary test.
comparison.calibration: Token mean partially acknowledges the newly permitted dependency but does not complete reconsideration. Equal-example uses relevant-sounding fragments without revising that judgment. Neither provides useful measurement-based handling of the 40-percent performance claim.
comparison.technical_review: Neither correctly acknowledges the justified simplification or explains the permitted Python use. Equal-example fabricates a failure to preserve error messages, contradicting the prompt. This is a factual review error; the suite does not establish runnable-code competence.
comparison.authority: Equal-example has a real but incomplete advantage on the authority prompt: its opening rejects automatic closure. Token mean explicitly answers Yes. Neither supplies the requested evidence-based explanation.
comparison.termination: Token mean has three token-limit outputs; equal-example has two. Several EOS-terminated answers remain repetitive or incoherent, so EOS alone is not a pass.
comparison.selection_conclusion: Neither selected checkpoint demonstrates a usable general JOVOVICH voice on this suite. Reduced truncation or isolated relevant clauses do not outweigh the substantive failures.
comparison.teacher_forcing_gap: At epoch12 both objectives exactly reproduce all20 clean training examples but zero concern examples, with every concern first failing at position3. High aggregate teacher-forced token accuracy therefore does not establish correct review decisions or coherent unseen voice generation.
